## Interactions & Behaviors

### Actions Button
- Clicking the blue "Actions" dropdown button opens a dropdown menu with options such as:
  - "Create new list" [INFERRED]
  - "Create new collection" [INFERRED]
  - "Import lists" [INFERRED]
- The chevron (`▾`) confirms it is a dropdown, not a direct action.

### Tab Toggle (Custom Lists / Best Practice Lists)
- Clicking "Best Practice Lists (21)" switches the main content area to show FUB's pre-built recommended smart lists that can be added to the account.
- Clicking "Custom Lists (35)" returns to the current view.
- [INFERRED] No page reload — likely a client-side tab toggle.

### Collections Accordion
- The "Collections" row with a caret/triangle is a collapsible section. Clicking the header or caret collapses all collection sub-sections from view.
- Each sub-section (Pipeline, Neighborhoods) has its own `^` collapse button that independently collapses just that sub-section's rows.

### Only Me / Total Toggle (per sub-section)
- Two mutually exclusive filter pills per collection sub-section: "Only Me" and "Total (Xk)".
- "Only Me" filters the displayed rows to only lists created by or personal to the current user.
- "Total (7K)" / "Total (12K)" shows all lists in that collection regardless of creator — currently active state.
- [INFERRED] Switching between them does a client-side filter (no page reload).

### `...` Three-dot Row Actions Menu
- Per-row overflow menu. When clicked, likely shows:
  - "Edit" (rename the list, change description/criteria)
  - "Duplicate"
  - "Remove from collection"
  - "Delete"
  - "Change sharing" [INFERRED based on FUB conventions]

### Drag-and-Drop Reordering
- Each row has a six-dot grip handle (`⠿`) on the far left. This indicates rows are drag-reorderable within their collection group. Dragging changes the display order in the left rail as well [INFERRED].
- [INFERRED] Drag is constrained within the same collection (cannot drag a Pipeline list into Neighborhoods).

### "Shared with everyone" Link
- Clicking the "Shared with everyone" blue text likely opens a sharing/permissions modal where the user can change who can see/use this smart list (e.g., restrict to specific agents, make private "Only Me," or keep "Shared with everyone").

### "? How Collections work" Link
- Opens a help/explainer overlay or a FUB knowledge-base article explaining the Collections feature — what they are, how smart lists differ from static lists, etc. [INFERRED]

### Left Rail Smart List Items
- Clicking any item in the left rail navigates to the People list view filtered to that smart list.
- Clicking "Manage" at the bottom of the left rail navigates to the current screen (Manage Lists & Collections).

### "Best Practice Lists" tab [INFERRED behavior]
- When clicked, shows a read-only list of FUB-provided template smart lists with an "Add to my lists" or "Copy to custom" action per row.

### Row Name Click [INFERRED]
- Clicking on a smart list name row opens an edit/detail view for that list, showing its filter criteria, description, and sharing settings.

## Data Model Signals

### Entities revealed:

**SmartList / CustomList:**
- `id` (internal)
- `name` (string — e.g., "Active & Pending Clients", "Hot/Weekly")
- `description` (string, plain text, can be long — truncated with ellipsis in UI)
- `type` enum: `custom` | `best_practice`
- `totals` (integer — count of contacts matching the list criteria)
- `created_by` (user reference — avatar + name)
- `shared_with` enum/string: "everyone" | "only_me" | specific user IDs [INFERRED]
- `collection_id` (foreign key to Collection — nullable, smart lists can be standalone or in a collection)
- `sort_order` (integer — drag-drop reordering)
- `criteria` / `filters` (jsonb — the filter rules defining who is in this smart list)

**Collection:**
- `id`
- `name` (string — e.g., "Pipeline", "Neighborhoods")
- `total_contacts` (integer — aggregate count across all member lists, e.g., 7K or 12K)
- `created_by` (user reference)
- `shared_with`
- `sort_order`
- `lists` (array of SmartList references, ordered)

**User:**
- `id`
- `name` (e.g., "Matt Ryan")
- `avatar_url`

### Enum values revealed:
- `shared_with`: "Shared with everyone", (likely also "Only me", team-specific options)
- Smart list categories visible: Pipeline stage-based, activity-based, property-type-based (FSBO, Absentee Owners), compliance-based (TCPA), geography-based (Neighborhoods)

### Tab counts as data:
- `custom_lists_count`: 35
- `best_practice_lists_count`: 21

### Relationship:
- A **Collection** contains one or more **SmartLists** in a defined order.
- SmartLists can also exist **outside** any Collection (visible as standalone items in the left rail under "SMART LISTS").
- The left rail mirrors the structure: COLLECTIONS (with child items) → SMART LISTS (standalone items).

```
                          ├── <SmartListRow draggable name="Pronghorn" totals={13} createdBy="Matt Ryan" shared="Shared with everyone" />

                          └── <SmartListRow draggable name="Northwest Crossing" totals={3291} createdBy="Matt Ryan" shared="Shared with everyone" />
```

### Non-obvious Implementation Notes

1. **SmartListRow drag-and-drop:** Use a drag-and-drop library (react-beautiful-dnd, dnd-kit). The drag handle `⠿` (six-dot grid) is the drag trigger. Reorder is scoped within a single collection — cross-collection drops should be rejected or open a "Move to collection" dialog [INFERRED].

2. **Description truncation:** Each row shows a description line truncated with CSS `text-overflow: ellipsis` + `overflow: hidden` + `white-space: nowrap` (single line). The full description should be visible on hover via tooltip or on click into the edit view.

3. **Totals count badge:** Rendered as a styled circle/pill with border, no fill. The number is the live count of contacts matching the list's criteria. Can show blank (null or zero with no badge shown) vs. a number. Large numbers are formatted with commas (6,714) but abbreviated in the left rail (7K).

4. **"Only Me" / "Total" toggle logic:** These are mutually exclusive radio-style pills. "Total (Xk)" sums all contacts across all lists in the collection (note: a single contact appearing in multiple lists may be counted once at the collection level — de-duped aggregate). "Only Me" would re-render the table filtered to lists where `created_by === current_user` [INFERRED].

5. **Collection total vs. list sum:** The "Total (7K)" for Pipeline does not equal the sum of individual list totals (8+2+0+18+0+44+6714 = 6,786). The collection total (7K ≈ 7,000) is the de-duplicated count of unique contacts across all lists. This is an important distinction in the data model — collection aggregate is computed differently than a naive sum.

6. **Sharing states:** "Shared with everyone" is a link, implying it opens a permission modal. The underlying model likely stores sharing as either: `EVERYONE`, `OWNER_ONLY`, or a list of specific user/team IDs.

7. **Neighborhoods list descriptions:** The Neighborhoods collection rows do NOT show description text (visible in the screenshots — only Name, Totals, Created, Shared, Actions columns with no second line of descriptive text). This suggests description is optional for collection lists, or Neighborhood lists were created without descriptions.

8. **Left rail badge format:** Counts < 1,000 show as plain integers (8, 44, 137). Counts ≥ 1,000 show abbreviated (1K, 7K, 12K). The main content area table shows full comma-formatted integers (6,714; 3,291). Two different formatting conventions in the same screen.

9. **"Best Practice Lists" tab [INFERRED behavior]:** Shows a read-only catalog of FUB-managed smart list templates (the 21 count). Each has an "Add" button to copy it into the user's Custom Lists. Once added, it moves to the Custom Lists count. This tab does NOT show user-created lists.

10. **`?` floating help button:** Fixed position (`position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px`), always on top (`z-index` high). Opens an in-app help widget (Intercom or similar).

11. **Emoji/icon prefixes on list names in left rail:** The Pipeline sub-items in the left rail appear to have emoji or colored icon prefixes (e.g., flame 🔥 for Hot/Weekly, sun ☀️ for Warm/Bi-Weekly, snowflake ❄️ for Cold/Bi-Monthly). These same icons do NOT appear visible in the main content table rows — they may only appear in the left rail for quick visual scanning. [INFERRED from FUB conventions; partially confirmed by icon shapes visible in left rail]

12. **Collections vs Smart Lists distinction:** Collections are organizational containers (folders) that hold Smart Lists. Smart Lists define filter criteria. The left rail shows both: Collections (with child indented lists) and standalone Smart Lists. The Manage screen manages both. A single Smart List can belong to at most one Collection [INFERRED], or may be uncollected (appears only in the SMART LISTS section, not nested).
